title: Alignment whack-a-mole: Finetuning activates recall of copyrighted books in LLMs
cleaned_content: New research demonstrates that finetuning LLMs on copyrighted books can trigger verbatim recall of those texts, even if previously unmemorized. This highlights a significant challenge for model alignment and intellectual property compliance, showing how a standard practice like finetuning can inadvertently increase copyright risks. The paper provides open-source tools for evaluation and finetuning on various models.
